exact_packet.scope: The seven exact artifact SHA-256 identities below, including schema, semantics, architecture, engineering values, examples, planned cases and change matrix.

local_freeze.question: What exact new contract version/tag should we assign, and do you authorize its local commit/tag freeze once the required gates are satisfied? GitHub pushes and component implementation would remain separately gated.
local_freeze.scope: Bridge Builder may select an unused contract release version and create its local specification commit/tag; no push or component implementation.

interpretation.authority: This release manifest binds the unchanged EP01-approved packet to the selected release identity and the preserved Alpha.20 v1 baseline.
interpretation.historical_metadata: Approval-pending wording, null release_version, proposal status and original workstation paths inside approved-packet are historical candidate metadata preserved byte-for-byte; this manifest supplies the current release identity, approval and portable bindings. No wire field or semantic rule is altered.
interpretation.v1: contract.json and fixtures/ retain the exact Alpha.20 Git blobs and v1 meanings; their embedded version is intentionally unchanged.
interpretation.v2: The typed artifact and companion semantics jointly specify v2, including the same-plugin Discourse network. Neither is an executable validator. Their disagreement must not be resolved silently.
interpretation.baseline_reference_override: The candidate's v1.contract_file and v1.fixtures_directory are authoring-workspace references. For this release use portable_bindings.v1_contract and portable_bindings.v1_fixtures_directory.
interpretation.document_links: Use the portable release index and approved_packet member paths, not original workstation hyperlinks, to navigate this committed packet.
interpretation.release_boundary: A local immutable specification identity is not an implemented product, code-review disposition, runtime qualification or deployment approval.

excluded.operator_service_control_documents: Not members of this release; invented remote Operator Service controls remain excluded.
excluded.historical_trash: Not an authority or implementation source.

later_gates.component_implementation: Separate explicit authority required; baseline-derived packets, native hooks, migration, packaging and installation work not performed.
later_gates.code_review: Not commissioned or issued for this specification freeze. Applicable later code-review gates must use the complete controlling doctrine; no prior disposition inherited.
later_gates.runtime_cases: 80 planned CMS/network runtime/native cases remain NOT_RUN.
later_gates.raw_json_negative_cases: Two planned malformed-JSON cases remain NOT_RUN.
later_gates.sandbox: No live test, installation, migration, protected credential or service access authorized by this freeze.
later_gates.github: No push, remote branch/tag/main update or remote cleanup authorized by this freeze.
later_gates.non_sandbox_deployment: Separately authorized only after sandbox qualification and an approved valid main.
